description: Low-confidence timbre (C02-T09b, SDR-43, experimental): a mallet series compiled with `experimental.lowConfidenceTimbre` on, one second each of exact values, estimates at confidence 1.0, estimates at 0.3 and exact values again. Every second plays the same three pitches, so the per-second centroid falls with the timbre alone: darker for the estimates, darkest at 0.3.
